name: wardhook-vscode
description: Find PII and prompt-injection risk in your code, without the text ever leaving your machine.

commands.title: Score Active File for Prompt Injection

enumDescriptions: General-purpose entities: email, phone, SSN, credit card, IP, API keys.
Insurance-specific entities layered on the default pack.
Healthcare entities such as NHS numbers, layered on the default pack.
Financial entities such as IBAN, layered on the default pack.
wardhook.pack.description: Built-in entity pack used for detection.

wardhook.customPackPath.description: Path to a custom entity pack YAML. Overrides wardhook.pack when set.

wardhook.minSeverity.description: Lowest severity reported as a diagnostic. Checksum-validated matches are always reported.

wardhook.validatedOnly.description: Report only matches confirmed by a checksum (Luhn, IBAN, NHS). Highest precision, lowest recall.

wardhook.scanOnType.description: Re-scan as you type. Disable to scan only on save.

wardhook.debounceMs.description: Idle time before re-scanning a changed document.

wardhook.excludeGlobs.description: Globs excluded from scanning. Test fixtures usually contain deliberate sample PII.

wardhook.maxFileSizeKb.description: Skip files larger than this, in kilobytes.

wardhook.injectionThreshold.description: Prompt-injection score at or above which text is reported.

wardhook.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter for the analyzer. Empty means use the Python extension's selected interpreter, then python3 on PATH.

wardhook.policyPackRepo.description: GitHub repo holding a shared entity pack, as owner/repo.

wardhook.policyPackPath.description: Path to the entity pack YAML inside wardhook.policyPackRepo.

chatParticipants.name: wardhook
chatParticipants.description: Find and redact PII, score prompt-injection risk, inspect entity packs.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Scan the active file, or the workspace, for PII.

commands.name: redact
commands.description: Show the active file or selection with PII redacted.

commands.name: packs
commands.description: List the entity packs and what each one detects.

commands.name: policy
commands.description: Check whether a role may call a named tool.

languageModelTools.name: wardhook_scan_pii
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find personal data in a file or snippet.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Detect personally identifiable information in a file or a text snippet. Returns one record per match with the entity type, character offsets, line number, severity and whether a checksum validated it. The matched value itself is never returned. Use this before sharing code, logs or prompts.

filePath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to scan. Omit to use `text`.

text.description: Raw text to scan. Ignored when `filePath` is given.

pack.description: Entity pack. Defaults to the configured one.

languageModelTools.name: wardhook_redact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace every detected piece of personal data in a file or snippet with a typed placeholder such as [US_SSN] or [CREDIT_CARD]. Returns the redacted text plus a count per entity type. Use this to produce a safe-to-share version of something.

filePath.description: Path whose contents to redact. Omit to use `text`.

text.description: Raw text to redact. Ignored when `filePath` is given.

languageModelTools.name: wardhook_scan_workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Scan every matching file in the open workspace for personal data and return a rollup: total matches, a breakdown by entity type and severity, and the worst files ranked. Respects the configured exclude globs. Use this to answer questions about the project as a whole rather than one file.

include.description: Glob of files to scan. Defaults to common source and text files.

maxFiles.description: Stop after this many files. Defaults to 500.

languageModelTools.name: wardhook_score_injection
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Score a file or snippet for prompt-injection signals such as instruction overrides, role reassignment, exfiltration requests and obfuscated payloads. Returns a score from 0 to 1, the threshold, a severity band, and which signal categories fired with their weights. This is a whole-text score with no character offsets, so do not present it as a highlighted span.

filePath.description: Path to score. Omit to use `text`.

text.description: Raw text to score. Ignored when `filePath` is given.

threshold.description: Score at or above which text counts as blocked. Defaults to the configured value.

languageModelTools.name: wardhook_list_packs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the built-in entity packs (default, insurance, healthcare, fintech) and the entity types each one detects. Use this to pick the right pack for a domain before scanning, or to answer what the tool is capable of detecting.

languageModelTools.name: wardhook_explain_entity
languageModelTools.userDescription: Explain how one entity type is detected.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Explain how a single entity type is detected: its severity, its placeholder, whether a checksum validator confirms it (Luhn, IBAN, NHS), and any context words the rule requires nearby. Use this when asked why something was or was not flagged.

entity.description: Entity name, such as US_SSN or CREDIT_CARD.

languageModelTools.name: wardhook_check_tool_policy
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check whether a role may call a tool.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Given a role-to-tool-pattern policy, check whether a named role is permitted to call a named tool. Patterns support wildcards such as lookup_*. Returns the decision and the pattern that decided it. Use this to reason about agent tool permissions before wiring them up.

role.description: Role to test, such as support_agent.

tool.description: Tool name to test, such as issue_refund.

policy.description: Role to allowed tool patterns, e.g. {"support_agent": ["lookup_*"]}.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile
